about.title: hi, i'm Priyanshu
about.description: backend engineer with 4.5+ years spent designing scalable microservices, wrangling payment systems, and shipping cloud-native services.
paragraphs: I’m a backend nerd who loves building systems that don’t fall over at 2am. Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis & AWS are my everyday toolkit for keeping things fast and reliable.

At GeekyAnts I helped build systems that move millions in payments and power smooth digital experiences. I’m happiest untangling messy systems, simplifying the complicated, and shaving milliseconds off slow queries.

experience.description: Building scalable backend systems and microservices for enterprise clients
achievements: Contributed to the backend development of Bleacher Report, working on Node.js services and GraphQL APIs to support high-traffic sports content delivery, optimizing data fetching and improving API performance and scalability.

Implemented comprehensive monitoring and observability using Datadog metrics, dashboards, and alerts to track system health, performance bottlenecks, and error rates, improving production visibility and reducing downtime.

projects.name: AI-Powered HR Assistant
projects.shortDescription: AI chatbot handling 1,000+ daily HR queries with 92% accuracy using GPT-4 and vector search.
projects.longDescription: Built intelligent AI chatbot handling 1,000+ daily HR queries (policies, leaves, notices) using LangChain and OpenAI GPT-4, achieving 92% query resolution accuracy and reducing HR workload by 45%. Integrated PostgreSQL with SQL Agents for DML operations, processing 500+ database transactions daily with 99.9% data integrity and <50ms query response time. Implemented FAISS vector embeddings for semantic search across 10,000+ documents, improving search accuracy by 25% and reducing search latency from 2 seconds to 300ms.

Applied Strategy and Factory design patterns for provider selection and instantiation, improving code maintainability by 40% and reducing duplicate code by 65%.
